messages:
maya: Heads-up — Nebula Systems goes live on OrbitCloud marketplace next Tue. Need to finalise partner SEV path and shared war-room flow. Who's taking bridge runner and what's the channel name?

sam: I can be bridge runner first 24h. channel = #partners-nebula-sev ?

jules: agree on channel name. We'll create the channel as private and invite Nebula L2 only after triage stage. Also: add escalation tags: `sev1`, `sev2`, `sev3`.

ana (sre): tagging in runbook checklist: on SEV1 -> open war room, add oncall, notify partner PM, escalate to infra lead at T+30m if no progress. I put a minimal snippet below for copy: 
```
SEV1: open war-room -> @bridge-runner -> add oncall -> first 15m triage -> escalate infra lead @sam if blocking >30m
SEV2: notify partner PM + support async, open thread in channel
```

nia: I'll own partner comms template and joint statement cadence (internal cadence for PR/marketing). For any customer-impacting SEV we follow the joint-announcement checklist and notify PR within 60m.

maya: Good. @sam can you confirm oncall handoff times? Also need phone/zoom bridge for Nebula L2 — Leo gave +1-555-843-9000 and zoom link. I will DM to channel owners.

sam: Oncall handoff: we'll have SRE primary 08:00-20:00 PT, ENG fallback 20:00-08:00. I'll add daily 09:00 quick sync in the war room for first 72h.

jules: Ops notes: enable `incident-bot` auto-post when channel is created so we get paging. deploy-bot: create channel template and include pinned runbook, contact card, and postmortem checklist.

deploy-bot: Created channel skeleton: #partners-nebula-sev (private). Pinned docs: runbook.md, partner-contacts.md, postmortem-template.md. Invite list: maya, sam, ana, nia.

maya: Thanks. Final items: 1) confirm partner L2 contact is reachable on Slack and Zoom; 2) legal/PR notify list; 3) marketplace ops has deploy flag to roll back listing — sam can you confirm rollback owner?

sam: Rollback owner = marketplace-ops oncall (cc @jules). I'll document rollback run steps in the pinned runbook.

mia: (not in thread) sending quick thumbs. :thumbsup:

jules: I'll do a short drill in the channel tomorrow 16:00 PT — 10 min walk-through of the flow. Everyone ok?

maya: Perfect. I'll send partner-facing comms and final channel invite. If anything changes, post here. :rocket:
